Purpose
- [ ] New chapter
- [ ] Revision of an existing chapter

Target file: chapters/NN-title.md

Chapter details
- ChapterNumber:
- TargetWords: (2,000-3,000; note if outside this range)
- FocalCharacter:
- ContinuityNotes: (how this fits outline.md, and any deviations)

Checklist
- [ ] npm run check passes
- [ ] File named chapters/NN-title.md
- [ ] 2,000-3,000 words (or deviation noted above)
- [ ] Matches STYLE.md (voice, tense, POV) or notes divergence
- [ ] Outline.md consulted; chapter maps to its Act/beat, or divergence is noted in ContinuityNotes
- [ ] Cast and character names are consistent with STYLE.md

Summary of changes
- Briefly describe what this PR adds or revises and why (e.g., which weak spot a revision addresses, per group review comments).

Reviewer notes
- Suggested reviewers or areas needing extra attention:
- Related chapter-review issue (if any): #

Thank you for contributing to the novel.
